what: Real-world checks for rule 2f (Sun Nov 15, 8:15-8:45 PM CT).

room_and_mic_stress.how: Every TEST-half clip re-recorded through a simulated kitchen and laptop mic: 0.4 s reverb, 120 Hz-7 kHz band, -12 dB, hiss at 20 dB SNR (Ubicoustics-style). One 10-s window per clip, app rules, before day-bar smoothing. Kitchen20 limited to clips TEST under both the source split and the uploader split.
room_and_mic_stress.finding: Kitchen recognition collapses through a room and laptop mic (DESED 85% clean -> 20%; Kitchen20 63% -> 9%). The detector helps (30%, 19%). Loudness normalisation helps most (70%, 55% with the detector) but raises false kitchen and could not be checked on SINS (cached scores only), so it is not shipped.

browser_end_to_end.how: web/test/e2e.py flow in Chromium with a fake microphone playing 100 s of TEST-half dish, frying and chopping clips passed through the same simulated room; the room screen read every 2 s (50 readings). "now" = the same build with the detector removed from web/public/model/witness.json.
browser_end_to_end.note: one run per build; window timing shifts by about 5 readings between runs

guard: Sun Nov 15 ~9:30 PM CT: rule 2f called 27/260 off-list sounds (glass breaking 9, clapping 7, birds 5, thunderstorm 4, rain 1) kitchen activity. Guard added: a kitchen tag must be heard (k >= 0.03). Chosen after seeing that off-list result, so off-list is no longer a clean test for the guard; checked on the TUNE halves too.
